acceptanceCriteria: Each pattern has a rule id, a fixture that triggers it and one that does not.
By default only findings on lines added or changed since the base are reported; --all-lines reports all.
An inline annotation with a reason suppresses exactly the named rule there and is echoed in the report; one without a reason suppresses nothing.
Output is deterministic JSON; exit codes are 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 error.
Preflight can require a clean lint for the same tree.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1032 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem Reviewers keep returning browser tests for the same mechanical reasons, all visible in source before any run: no assertion; assertions only on visibility or URL; assertions inside an if/else or try/catch guarded by a visibility or count check; catch handlers that swallow wait errors; fixed sleeps or network-idle waits; tautological assertions; positional, CSS-class or xpath selectors; skip/only markers without a reason. Each costs a run plus a review round. Current workaround A local AST script runs before review and reports findings only on lines changed against the base revision. Proposal `corvint tests lint --base REV [--all-lines] [--json]` over changed test and page-object files, with a closed rule set, stable rule ids, file:line findings and a non-zero exit on findings. A structured inline annotation with a reason justifies one rule at that line. Usable as a preflight check See beamfall/corvint#1032 for the full text.
title: tests lint: static check of test source for non-asserting, conditional, swallowing and timing-dependent patterns (issue #1032)
